About.heading: How ACLIC came to be
About.unHeading: Recommendations submitted to the United Nations
About.foundingBody: ACLIC was initiated in August 2025 by children together with the Organization for Social Development (OSD). It launched with more than 50 member structures and its executive organs already formed.
About.growthBody: The coalition has continued to add member structures since, and works alongside the child parliament and partner organizations.
About.unBody: ACLIC submitted recommendations to the United Nations — before the coalition was even a fully defined and government-registered structure.
About.metaDescription: How ACLIC was founded in August 2025 and has grown since, including its submissions to the United Nations.

Structure.heading: Governance & structure
Structure.diagramCaption: The full governance chain, from the General Assembly down to each department.
Structure.assemblyBody: The General Assembly is the coalition's supreme organ, made up of its member structures.
Structure.leadershipBody: One President, two Vice Presidents, and a Secretary, above thirteen department heads leading the coalition's functional units.
Structure.ageNote: Every officeholder in this structure is under eighteen, and every seat is filled through election by member structures.
Structure.hostBody: The Organization for Social Development (OSD) is ACLIC's host organization and registered address.
Structure.bylawsNote: A public summary of the bylaws will be made available here when the coalition publishes one.
Structure.metaDescription: The full governance chain of ACLIC, from the General Assembly to its department heads — every seat held by someone under eighteen.

Membership.heading: Join ACLIC
Membership.whoBody: Membership is held by child-led structures, not by individuals. A structure joins the coalition; the young people within it take part until they turn eighteen.
Membership.involvesBody: Member structures take part in the General Assembly, contribute to department work, and take part in elections for coalition leadership.
Membership.applyNote: The application opens in a new tab.
